name: Jameson Davies
bio:
Jameson's journey into motorsport catering was a bit unconventional. Starting out as a line cook in his family's diner in rural Pennsylvania, he quickly developed a passion for creating high-quality meals under pressure. He saw an opportunity to combine his culinary skills with his love for speed when Speed Kart Racing came to town for a regional event. He impressed the team with his resourcefulness and dedication and was offered a full-time position shortly after.

As catering manager, Jameson is known for his uncompromising standards and relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes that even trackside meals should be an experience, and he's constantly experimenting with new recipes and presentation techniques. He is very particular with the food quality and preparation.

His dedication to providing the best possible culinary experience for the team, combined with his demanding personality, make him a unique and valuable asset to Speed Kart Racing. His commitment to excellence ensures that the drivers and crew are always fueled and ready to perform at their best.

physical.description: He is a stocky man with a sturdy build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using only organic ingredients, even if it means sourcing them from obscure locations.
Always has a clipboard with detailed notes about meal preferences and dietary restrictions.
Wears a chef's hat at all times, even when not actively cooking.
